what: H World Group, formerly Huazhu, is one of China's largest hotel groups. It operates and franchises budget and midscale brands including HanTing, JI Hotel and Orange, and owns Deutsche Hospitality in Europe.
customers: Chinese domestic business and leisure travellers, and hotel owners who franchise its brands.
money: fees from hotels owned by others and run under its brands
moat: A membership programme with hundreds of millions of Chinese members and a franchise system that fills rooms more cheaply than an independent hotel can.
risks: Chinese domestic travel spending has been soft and room rates have fallen
Debt of about $5.6 billion against $2.8 billion of cash
European hotels earn far lower margins than the Chinese business
Oversupply of budget hotels in Chinese cities pressures pricing
opportunities: Revenue grew about 11% last year and about 22% a year over three years
Operating margin of 27% with a dividend yield above 4%
Franchising keeps adding hotels without its own capital
watch: Revenue per available room in China and net hotel openings.
